extraction.notes: Three-month 2022 column from Attachment 2 (page 3). Starting line is net income attributable to common stockholders ($3,975), which is after Series E preferred distributions; the Attachment 15(B) NOI table shows net income attributable to UDR, Inc. of $5,084 (5,084 - 1,109 = 3,975). FFO subtotal used is the diluted figure ($180,437), so the Series E preferred distributions ($1,109) are placed among FFO adjustments as the bridge from basic to diluted FFO; basic FFO is $179,328. Zero-valued lines printed as '-' are included with amount 0. Checks: 3,975+167,584+280+7,489 = 179,328; +1,109 = 180,437; core adjustments sum to 16,573, giving 197,010; less recurring capex 18,411 gives 178,599. 344,024 diluted shares reproduce $0.52 FFO, $0.57 FFO as Adjusted and $0.52 AFFO. AFFO already deducts recurring capex, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
